## 3. The D-1 threshold derivation — the anchors' band + the pre-stated rule

**The derivation rule, fixed before the walk (pre-registration discipline):** the four FROZEN gold-lane thresholds are the anchors (the beam formula inherited — D-GF-2 — the derivation never touches them); each anchor's **move-firing share** is measured over all corpus windows (readable + a finite change30d: the share of windows where |change30d| exceeds the threshold); a seat earns a proposed threshold **only where** (a) its 02 v1.1 treatment is change-led or explicitly "level + change" and (b) its cadence is daily (the monthly/quarterly seats are cadence-exempt — `cadenceUsesPreviousRelease`, scoring.ts:425-427 — a threshold there would read "the release-to-release move", not a 30-day move); the derived VALUE = the smallest positive 2-decimal value (rounded UP, so the measured share sits at or under the median; zero excluded — a zero threshold is degenerate) whose exceedance share over the same basis is ≤ the anchors' median share (the new thresholds inherit the anchors' firing regime rather than inventing one). Everything else is **accept-with-note** with its reason stated per seat.

## 4. The scenarios — the C1/C2 re-derivation (the tables)

Definitions as GB-S1 fixed them: "level" = net 0 across the lane votes (the all-unread `none` state counted within level and reported separately); "fully tipped" = |net| = for + against (the one-sided 10° tip); "verdict flip" = a day-to-day change of the balance state; "flips per 60 trading days" = the median over every 60-trading-day window. **The decision rule (GB 02 §6, unchanged): use MIN2 if C1 and C2 hold; else MIN1 if C1 and C2 hold; if neither passes, STOP and bring the numbers to the owner.** The net-sign comparison figure is the SAME scenario's own raw voter net sign over the same windows (GB-S1's basis — "the 21-voter net sign" was the calibrated set's own count — applied to each scenario's own set). One visible effect of the D-18 input-presence rule, stated before the tables: the POST rows' dollar lane reads `unread` in the first 2 windows (2016-11-07/08 — the FX seats' histories begin ~2016-11-05, so neither the move input (no 30-day-back point yet) nor the level input (base < 30) exists yet; today's rule would read those `steady`) — the rule's honest rendering of a young series, 2 of 2512 windows.

**The mechanical verdict, stated plainly (the STOP branch fires for the proposed sets):** the FROZEN set re-affirms GB-S1's decision — **MIN2 passes both C1 and C2 on the all-windows scope** (and the mature-base C1 failure GB-S1 already recorded stands, stated not hidden). **Every proposed set FAILS the pre-registered C2 on the all-windows scope under BOTH crowd rules** — the repairs and the promotions make each set's own raw net sign SMOOTHER (the frozen net sign flips 9 per 60td; the post-P1 sets' 7; the post-P2 sets' 7 all / 4 mature) while the lane verdict's flips hold at 8–10 — a lane verdict that flips more often than the raw count it consolidates is exactly what C2 was pre-registered to catch. Per the protocol's own decision rule (GB 02 §6: "if neither passes, STOP and bring the numbers to the owner. Do not ship."), **the min-firing rule for the proposed sets is NOT selectable on this corpus: the numbers come to the owner with this report.** The measured shape behind the C2 failure, stated honestly and not narrated away: richer lanes vote MORE (each lane holds more voters, so the min-2 bar is reached more often) and a 4–5-lane net over more voting lanes flips more — the price of the coverage the promotions buy. The single POST row that passes both criteria on the mature scope (POST-P1-DEMOTE under MIN1: flips 6.5 vs 7) is stated for completeness — a fallback rule on the mature scope only, not a selection (the pre-registered criteria apply to ALL windows; GB-S1's own precedent).

## 5. The lane-count evidence — OI-GA-2 (4-lane vs 5-lane)

**The F-family's measured truth over the backfilled history (the D-4 repair simulated):** `cftc-gold-positioning` (F1, the net-share seat) is readable in 2512/2512 windows and **fires in 1008** (40.1%; supports 358 / pressures 650 — the contrarian polarity: crowded-long extremes read pressures); the F2 proxy (the gross-long share) is readable in 2512 and fires in 1055 (42.0%; supports 372 / pressures 683). The staged truth today (1 point, 0 firing windows — D-4) becomes a live, extreme-driven pair once the backfill lands: **the F-family's firing statistics are real, not hypothetical.**

**The 5-lane scenario's flows lane (F1 + the F2 proxy, over the backfilled history):** under MIN2 — for 286 · against 473 · neutral 1753 (of which split 0) · unread 0 of 2512 windows: **the lane votes in 759 windows (30.2%)** — the crowded-long extremes read against (pressures, the contrarian polarity) and the capitulation lows read for. Under MIN1 the lane votes in 1304 windows. The lane-count comparison on the C1/C2 criteria: POST-P2-4LANE (MIN2, all): level 25.3%, full-tip 20.8%, C1 PASS, C2 FAIL; POST-P2-5LANE (MIN2, all): level 24.2%, full-tip 16.0%, C1 PASS, C2 FAIL.

**The calibration's reading of OI-GA-2 (a measurement, not a forecast):** the 5th lane changes the C1/C2 verdicts by the measured deltas above and nothing else in the engine (the beam formula is lane-count-agnostic; the strong-bar re-statement for 5 lanes — GOLD_LANE_STRONG 3-of-4 → 3-of-5 or 4-of-5 — is an Outlook-copy question for the implementation phase, recorded here so it cannot be forgotten). The audit's structural evidence stands unchanged: a 16-row classic family with exactly one dead, solo seat (D-14) — a family muted structurally under the 4-lane fold. The owner decides; both compositions are now measured.

## 9. Honesty notes

1. **No forecasting claim, anywhere in this report.** The C1/C2 criteria measure legibility and stability — level shares, full-tip shares, verdict flips — never forward returns. No realised-move table was computed for any scenario (nothing was selected on returns; the GB-S1 lineage tables stand in BACKTEST-GOLD-LANES.md, labelled "not used for selection").
2. **Every cell carries n.** The window basis (2512 windows), the mature split (≥ 2021-09-23), the per-seat readable counts and the anchors' firing shares are all stated beside their numbers; the derivation rule was fixed before the walk (§3) and the scenario family before the runs (§1).
3. **The fixtures are the record.** The corpus is the frozen 2026-11-03 recording; the GF-P0 fixtures (the candidates + the CFTC backfill) are the 2026-11-05 recordings with their venues disclosed (the stage blob's writtenAt 2026-11-04T04:35:18.079Z; the ebp and jgb-10y fresh fetches). Re-running the recorder re-records; re-running the calibration over the committed fixtures reproduces this file byte-for-byte.
4. **The staged-truth boundaries, stated:** the promotion candidates' histories are the repo's own staged/fetched series (the data plane the meter actually holds); the CFTC backfill and the D-6 gap derivation are SIMULATIONS of the P1 repairs over free sources (the exact series the repairs would stage — the parses replicate the production adapters' own assertions). The F2 seat is a scenario PROXY for F2's P2-designable object (the gross-long share; the one-seat-or-two question and the gross-short complement are the P2 design questions).
5. **The known young-series effects, disclosed:** the candidates' percentile bases are young at the first windows (the staged series begin 2016-09-27-class dates, the same stage window as the corpus's own series); the monthly/quarterly candidates (michigan ×2 · m2-us · us-deficit-12m · epu-us · tpu-us · gpr-index · usd-reserve-share · ebp) read previous-release change semantics and their percentile bases are monthly-density (a decade of monthlies ≈ 120 points — the H2 bar's own reading). The mature-base scope carries the deep-base view beside the all-windows view, exactly as GB-S1 did.
